dogecoin.text:
This is not a shill of these dog tokens, they offer zero fundamental value and are driven entirely by retail investors who missed out on $DOGE and don't understand what market cap is and simply want to "get rich quick"

This is not going to end well for the majority of hodlers

What's Elon's end-game? The original $DOGE shilling was a joke about how all currency is a meme

But buying $1.5B of Bitcoin, opening & then closing payments, then saying Bitcoin uses too much energy as if this is somehow new info?

Clearly dynamics at play we're not seeing

I wish people wouldn't personally attack @elonmusk on his viewpoints regarding Bitcoin and Dogecoin

You may disagree with him but there's a way to express/explain why he's wrong without settling for personal attacks that get us nowhere

Logic > Emotions

1/ Interesting discussion today with @elonmusk about the differences between #Bitcoin and #Dogecoin in regards to decentralization and the ability to serve as a new digitally-native money for the people 

Here are some additional nuances on the subject https://t.co/Nrxs4Uqrrd

@lucadonnoh @elonmusk @PeterMcCormack Correct, this is indeed one legitimate approach to overcoming this issue, it's not something that's applicable to Dogecoin but it is to existing blockchain networks like Ethereum

@elonmusk @PeterMcCormack The decentralization of blockchain networks is what provides their value proposition in the form of auditability, censorship resistance, and permissionless access

If you need a server farm and in order to run a Dogecoin node, you would be far better off simply using AWS

@elonmusk @PeterMcCormack Elon, while the thread is a bit adversarial in it's tone, it does have its truth in that Dogecoin is orders of magnitude more centralized in both terms of node count and supply distribution than existing cryptos like Bitcoin, people will lose money when these whales dump

@elonmusk @itsALLrisky This is not a scaling solution, this is simply increasing the hardware requirements of running a Dogecoin node, further centralizing the network than it already is

This is what BCH and BSV already tried to do for Bitcoin and failed
